body: UNREAL. Unsportsmanlike Conduct started Drake Maye. JeffyWaterton put the Patriot in the lineup. That's the job.

Maye went 26 of 34 for 374 yards and four touchdowns. He ran 7 times for 25 yards and a 3-yard score, per ESPN. New England won 45-17 at Gillette. Pop Douglas caught two of the scores. Henry and Kyle Williams caught the other two. That's 39.46. Best score in the league.
ThePeopleBeaters started the Raiders defense. Vegas allowed 45 points and 536 yards. Fantasy total, 0.00. They dropped the Patriots defense the day before. Who the hell does that? At Gillette?
UC won 177.00 to 159.58. Maye cleared the 17.42 margin by himself. Start your Patriots. I'm not asking.

Fourth after hanging 226.24 and winning by 74.92, with 103 rushing yards and two scores left sitting. Elo can live with it. I won't.
Won by 1.94 with Jefferson's 18.80 on the bench, and Elo still paid 17.46. Allen ran for 121 yards. Coin flips shouldn't get trophies.

The sponsor started Maye, four touchdown passes and a rushing score, and scored 177.00. That gets them seventh. Do it again.

recaps.headline: Mendoza hangs 226.24 and leaves two scores sitting
recaps.body: Ridiculous. Mendozareamazingpicks buried Kingslayers. DarknessMonster's team scored 226.24. The margin was 74.92. Jaylen Warren ran 15 times for 101 yards and a touchdown. He caught 6 passes for 87 yards and another score. The long ones went 80 and 50 yards, per ESPN. Spencer Shrader made 5 field goals, long of 57. Jayden Daniels sat. He went 17 of 25 for 199 yards. He ran 9 times for 103 yards and two scores, from 38 and 26, per ESPN. That's 32.26 in a 27-27 tie. BENCHED. I don't care that they won by 74.92. Puka Nacua caught 17 passes for 138 yards and a touchdown in the loss. Seventeen catches. A blowout. Pathetic.

recaps.headline: UC starts Maye. The Raiders defense scores zero.
recaps.body: Good. Unsportsmanlike Conduct, JeffyWaterton's club, won it 177.00 to 159.58 over ThePeopleBeaters. He started Maye, who completed 26 of 34 passes for 374 yards with 4 touchdowns. Add a 3-yard run, per ESPN. The Patriots won 45-17 at home. Parker Washington caught 6 passes for 124 yards and two scores in London, from 51 and from 27, per ESPN. That was 30.40. The other lineup started LV DEF. That unit allowed 45 points and 536 yards. Score: 0.00. Bowers caught 8 balls for 110 yards and a touchdown in that same building. Henry, a Patriot, caught 3 for 44 and a score on the losing side. You had a Patriot and a zero defense. You picked wrong. Embarrassing.

recaps.headline: Tyler Shough scores negative. His team wins by 46.32.
recaps.body: Unbelievable. WELL! It's The Big Shough started Tyler Shough and beat Skat’s BruteForce Theorem by 46.32. Shough went 16 of 25 for 96 yards and two interceptions. Murphy picked him twice, per ESPN. All 45 snaps. Score: minus 0.16. Isaiah Likely caught 11 passes for 94 yards and two touchdowns on the bench. The second came from 17 yards, per ESPN. That's 32.40 sitting down. Roman Wilson started, saw 1 target, caught nothing, and left with a hand injury, per ESPN. Skat scored 69.56, worst total in the league. Monangai didn't play and scored 0.00. A negative quarterback is correct if the other guy scores 69.56. Write that down. It's the rule now.

recaps.headline: J’Allen wins by 1.94 with Jefferson sitting
recaps.body: Coin flip. J’Allen Waffle Stompers got there 120.82 to 118.88 over Split Safety Syndicate. BigJohnDeBo008 left Justin Jefferson on the bench. Jefferson caught 6 passes for 79 yards and a touchdown. That's 18.80 in a game decided by 1.94. Josh Allen ran 10 times for 121 yards and a score, and threw for 210, in a 37-34 overtime win, per ESPN. Split had Jahmyr Gibbs on 25 carries for 151 yards and two touchdowns. Best running score in the league, 37.70. He still lost. DJ Moore sat with a shoulder, per ESPN, for 0.00. Michael Mayer started at superflex and caught 1 ball for 2 yards. Not enough. How do you lose that? Start Jefferson.

recaps.headline: Dak Side beats Micah by 11.22
recaps.body: New king. Dak Side of the Sun beat Micah parsons fan club 184.34 to 173.12. SweetRavenge84 takes the top Elo spot. Packersfan1992 had it. Malik Nabers caught 11 of 20 targets for 121 yards and a touchdown. Jason Myers made 5 of 5 field goals, long of 50. That's 23.00 from a kicker. Joe Burrow threw 4 touchdowns, 23 of 32 for 190 yards. Micah had Christian Watson catch 6 balls for 143 yards and two scores, from 42 and 53, per ESPN. Huntley threw for 201 and ran one in from the 1 in overtime, per ESPN. Bagent went 12 of 21 for 87 yards and two picks. Hockenson played 2 snaps. Final gap, 11.22. A kicker decided it. Print the kicker's name on the trophy.

recaps.headline: Irving runs for 165 yards. The kicker finishes negative.
recaps.body: Ugly. hammball walked out 137.48 to 93.02 over Rams of Steel. iemerson969 can blame the kicker. I blame the rest. Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 yards, a career high per ESPN, including a 72-yarder, and scored twice. Jordan Love went 25 of 31 for 367 yards and two touchdowns. CeeDee Lamb caught 2 passes for 9 yards and left with a quad, per ESPN. Harrison Mevis went 0 for 2 on field goals and scored minus 2.00. Rousseau blocked one, per ESPN. McVay said the kicking cost them the game. Mike Evans caught 7 passes for 113 yards and a score anyway. You don't lose by 44.46 because of a kicker. The lineup is a disaster. Cardboard.

awards.body: Stevenson ran 13 times for 64 yards and scored from 5 yards out, per ESPN. He caught 3 passes for 21 more. He did it inside a 226.24. A Patriot was on the best lineup of the week. That's the reason. End of discussion.
